name: check_inventory
description: Check inventory levels for a product SKU across all locations: on-hand, reserved, available-to-sell, in-transit, location breakdown, days of supply, reorder point, and ABC class.

name: get_inventory_summary
description: Get inventory health summary for a product category or all categories: in-stock rate, stockout and overstock counts, inventory value, turnover, and alerts.

category.description: Product category (One of: all, electronics, apparel, grocery, home, sports; Default: all)

name: transfer_stock
description: Initiate an inter-location stock transfer between warehouses/stores. Returns transfer confirmation with estimated delivery.

quantity.description: Number of units to transfer (positive integer)

name: get_stockout_report
description: Get the current stockout and low-stock report across all locations with estimated revenue impact per item, reorder status, and prioritization recommendation.
